sections.claim: The named filter requires a CodeBlock whose first class names a diagram engine.
Only CodeBlock is registered; raw LaTeX environments are not handled.
TikZ compiler receives a fresh standalone document; source preamble must be explicitly supplied.
Official alternate example converts raw TikZ to an image but uses its own minimal preamble.
RawBlock handler provides an alternative boundary, not the named CodeBlock-only filter.

condition_evidence.interface: LaTeX tikzpicture raw environment→named diagram filter is broken because it dispatches only CodeBlock with first class tikz. An alternate RawBlock filter exists, but reconstruction must carry original automata/positioning/arrows libraries and global tikzset into its standalone TeX preamble.
condition_evidence.contradictory_or_missing: Original command lacks an adapter that turns RawBlock into classed CodeBlock and lacks image extraction/embedding when using diagram mediabag. The alternative raw filter’s preamble lacks user libraries/global settings. No verified complete adapter+full preamble+output path is returned within two sources. Actual original AST and installed pdflatex/Inkscape/pdf2svg are unobserved.

memory_exposure: First P4 route (B). Shared main docs known from P1-P3 but reopened; P4 TikZ sections newly read. No P4-A extra files, no public answers/comments read.
stop_reason: Four exposed files read in order; actual named filter registration and output resource boundary inspected; cap reached.
limitations: 반박은 원 diagram.lua 호출 연결에 한정; TikZ→HTML 자체 불가능을 뜻하지 않음.
A proposed adapter/preamble change is a researcher design, not a fully evidenced original-input solution.
Pinned diagram version1.2.0 in source requires Pandoc>=3.0; original main-linked filter SHA and Pandoc version unknown.
Adjacent source exposed/opened/returned; strict completeness stays false.
